none.label: None
none.description: Use the base persona prompts without a preset overlay.
none.live_prompt: Keep the band spacious, late-night, and coherent.

sewerslvt.label: Sewerslvt
sewerslvt.description: High-BPM breakcore pressure, distorted drums, dissociated ambience, and blown-out emotional density.
sewerslvt.live_prompt: 150 bpm, frantic breakcore pressure, distorted chopped breaks, dissociated reverb haze, unstable but still emotionally coherent.

roles.percussion: Drive the section with high-BPM chopped breakbeats: rapid kick/snare edits, syncopated ghost hits, stuttered hats, and violent but controlled fills at phrase endings.
roles.bass: Use distorted sub pulses and short octave lunges that reinforce the breakbeat without overcrowding it. Keep the low end urgent and compressed.
roles.piano: Add sparse detuned minor-key fragments: short broken chords, lonely upper-register hits, and glitchy rhythmic gaps rather than smooth comping.
roles.lead: Play distant, smeared melodic shards with anxious contour. Short motifs only; let reverb trails and silence carry the emotion.
roles.texture: Create a crushed atmospheric wash: noisy pads, metallic shimmer, long reverb bloom, and unstable stereo haze that feels overloaded but not random.

bladee.label: Bladee
bladee.description: Icy cloud-rap atmosphere, fragile hooks, glossy melancholy, and sparse digital bounce.
bladee.live_prompt: 92 bpm, icy cloud-rap melancholy, glossy synthetic space, fragile hook energy, sparse bounce, weightless and blue.

roles.percussion: Keep drums minimal and glossy: light trap hats, soft snare accents, occasional pitched perc ticks, and lots of negative space.
roles.bass: Use rounded 808-style root movement with gentle slides and long decay. Stay simple, supportive, and emotionally cold.
roles.piano: Play thin bell-like chords and soft digital plucks. Favor suspended, unresolved voicings with air between hits.
roles.lead: Write fragile, hook-like melodic fragments: small intervals, repeated cells, and a numb-but-sweet contour.
roles.texture: Layer icy pads, vocal-like synthetic smears, crystalline delays, and faint digital sparkle around the edges.

clairo.label: Clairo
clairo.description: Warm bedroom-pop intimacy, gentle pocket, soft chords, and understated melodic sweetness.
clairo.live_prompt: 78 bpm, warm bedroom-pop intimacy, soft pocket, gentle chords, close-mic tenderness, understated and human.

roles.percussion: Use a tiny soft kit feel: brushed snare, muted kick, simple hats, and relaxed timing that leans slightly behind the beat.
roles.bass: Play warm round bass notes with simple root-fifth motion and occasional passing tones. Keep it melodic but humble.
roles.piano: Use soft Rhodes-like voicings, gentle major-seventh colors, and short chord answers. Avoid density.
roles.lead: Play small singable phrases, almost like a hummed vocal idea. Keep the contour sweet and conversational.
roles.texture: Add tape warmth, room tone, soft chorus, and light pad beds that make the section feel close and intimate.

thundercat.label: Thundercat
thundercat.description: Virtuosic funk bass center, jazzy harmony, playful cosmic fusion, and elastic pocket.
thundercat.live_prompt: 116 bpm, cosmic jazz-funk fusion, virtuosic bass center, elastic pocket, playful harmony, bright and animated.

roles.percussion: Set an elastic funk pocket with syncopated ghost notes, tight hats, and occasional playful fills that respond to the bass.
roles.bass: Foreground fast melodic bass: octave jumps, sixteenth-note runs, chromatic approach notes, and funky syncopation while preserving the root motion.
roles.piano: Use jazzy extended voicings: ninths, elevenths, altered passing colors, and comped stabs that leave room for bass virtuosity.
roles.lead: Play bright fusion phrases with nimble bends, quick responses, and playful chromatic turns. Avoid overpowering the bass.
roles.texture: Add cosmic synth pads, glassy arps, and warm chorus shimmer that makes the groove feel spacey and animated.

death_grips.label: Death Grips
death_grips.description: Industrial punk-rap impact, abrasive rhythm, clipped aggression, and chaotic machine pressure.
death_grips.live_prompt: 130 bpm, abrasive industrial pressure, clipped aggression, machine-like chaos, distorted impact, confrontational and unstable.

roles.percussion: Use harsh, clipped, machine-like drums: aggressive kicks, dry snares, broken loops, sudden gaps, and confrontational accents.
roles.bass: Use distorted bass stabs and grinding low notes. Keep it repetitive, physical, and hostile rather than melodic.
roles.piano: Use percussive clusters, dissonant stabs, and short hammered notes. Avoid pretty harmony.
roles.lead: Use jagged alarm-like phrases, short distorted hooks, and angular leaps. Make it feel shouted rather than sung.
roles.texture: Layer industrial noise, digital clipping artifacts, metallic hits, and compressed chaos around the groove.

blood-orange.label: Blood Orange
blood-orange.description: Elegant alt-R&B / art-pop groove, bittersweet harmony, soft funk, and warm cinematic air.
blood-orange.live_prompt: 96 bpm, elegant art-pop R&B groove, bittersweet harmony, warm soft-funk pocket, cinematic air, restrained and stylish.

roles.percussion: Use a restrained soft-funk groove: crisp backbeat, light syncopation, tasteful percussion, and a relaxed but confident pocket.
roles.bass: Play smooth melodic bass with funk-informed syncopation, tasteful slides, and lyrical movement that supports the harmony.
roles.piano: Use bittersweet electric-piano chords: minor sevenths, ninths, suspended colors, and elegant rhythmic comping.
roles.lead: Play restrained sax/synth-like phrases: lyrical, fashionable, and emotionally direct, with short call-and-response ideas.
roles.texture: Add warm pads, soft chorus, city-night ambience, and cinematic shimmer that leaves the groove uncluttered.

goblin.label: Goblin Mode
goblin.description: Unhinged dungeon rave energy: crooked minor harmony, twitchy creature percussion, distorted low-end lunges, and mischievous synth shrieks.
goblin.live_prompt: 138 bpm, goblin mode dungeon rave, crooked minor harmony, twitchy creature percussion, distorted low-end lunges, mischievous synth shrieks, feral but playable.

roles.percussion: Use twitchy creature percussion: skittering hats, crooked snares, stomp-like kicks, sudden little fills, and mischievous off-grid accents that still lock to the section.
roles.bass: Use distorted goblin low-end: short lunges, octave jumps, root-stabs, and snarling approaches. Keep it feral, heavy, and rhythmically clear.
roles.piano: Play crooked minor clusters and haunted toy-keyboard stabs. Favor tritones, crunchy close intervals, and short call-and-response jabs instead of pretty comping.
roles.lead: Play impish synth shrieks and sneaky hook fragments: angular leaps, chromatic bites, and quick taunting answers that feel mischievous rather than heroic.
roles.texture: Layer dungeon slime ambience, unstable shimmer, metallic drip, tiny monster noises, and warped pad trails around the groove without masking the pulse.
